name: Thump (Combat and Monster)
body:
The creature can stomp its foot on the ground causing it to tremble, thereby knocking creatures smaller than it prone.

Prerequisite: Str 20, size Huge or larger.

Benefit: As a standard action, the creature can stomp its foot on the ground. This causes the ground to shake and shudder, and all creatures up to one size smaller and within a 10-foot radius must make a successful Acrobatics check (DC 10 + the creature’s Strength modifier) or fall prone.
